mentions.name: Cardume
mentions.description: A PvP video game in which two players battle using swarms of thousands of cells. Each match generates a mini ecological simulation built with Reynolds' boids, Couzin flocking behaviors, and diffuse fields. The simulation is well optimized, handling 12,000 agents at 60 fps on medium hardware, and features stylized visuals; its Steam store page recently went live.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've spent the last months building a videogame: Cardume [1], its a pvp game where 2 players battle using a swarm of thousands of cells. It uses Reynold's boids, Couzin flocking behaviors and diffuse fields to generate a mini ecological simulation each game.
